reel_1.source: shot 1 (BUILD_PLAN): the tape slides into the oil from frame 0 - a soft reel whirr, 0 .. 46

flaps_1.source: sets_ext.ts flapState (probed): each LOANS digit flips every T f from s(i) and lands on land(i)

horn_1.source: shot 1: the far ship (harbour) in the pull-out: its horn INSIDE the pause after '$150 million...' (millionEnd + 3), faded out before 'tanks'

gull_1.source: shot 1: a gull cries as it flaps off the rail in the gap after 'water.' (CHAR: the rail gull takes off ~water1 + 9)

wings_1.source: shot 1: the rail gull's wing flaps as it takes off (CHAR cast.ts gull(..., 150, 238))

wings_1_land.source: shot 1: the rail gull flutters down onto the rail (CHAR: flies in 136 -> lands 150)

horn_2.source: A3 ADD: a far ship's horn across the harbour, deep under 'New Jersey's' (1-4 kHz carved)

halyard_2.source: A3 ADD: the gate flagpole's halyard clinks on the pole in the 'king.|His' breath (the gust that snaps the flag)

gull_2.source: shot 2: a gull over the tank farm in the gap after 'king.'

clank_2.source: shot 2: a far clank across the tank farm (under 'giant tanks')

plip_2.source: sets_ext.ts: the drip leaves the valve at oil1End - 6 and lands 12 f later (u = 1) = oil1End + 6

stamp_3.source: cast.ts / sets_int.ts: the stamp comes down on 'money' (|f - money| < 5), the APPROVED mark from money + 2

cash_3.source: sets_int.ts: the cash slides on 'against it' - smooth((f - againstIt) / 16)

register_3.source: the cash lands (againstIt + 16): A2 P2 - the register's ka-CHING plays in the breath after the WORD 'it.' (never inside it), its bell ringing into 'American'

chair_3.source: A2 ADD: the banker's leather chair creaks as he leans into the stamp (money - 6)

climb_4.source: cast.ts S4.pulls (probed): a rung clang on every hand-over-hand pull of the climb

rim_4.source: cast.ts S4.rim (probed): he swings over the rim (a last clang), onto the roof by S4.onRoof

roof_4.source: cast.ts scurry (probed): round the hatch from S4.onRoof, a footfall every 6.5 f (phase / 13, a step per half cycle)

knee_4.source: cast.ts S4.kneel (probed): he drops to his knees on the far side of the hatch

reel_4.source: sets_ext.ts: the tape pays out k4 = smooth((f - drop) / (inside1 + 16 - drop))

plunk_4.source: sets_ext.ts PLUNK (probed): the plumb weight hits the oil (+ the hollow tank's ring)

gulls_4.source: shot 4 A: far gulls circling the tank top (soft, -38 / -28 LU; 'up,|drop' gap)

gull_perch_4.source: sets_ext.ts tOff (probed): the gull perched on the rail by the shout spot is startled into the air by 'full!' (wings; a squawk in the breath after the shout)

gull_far_4.source: shot 4B (the ground two-shot after the hard cut): a far gull wheels over the yard in the 'inspector,|on' gap

stand_4.source: cast.ts S4.stand + scurry (probed): he rises, then scurries round to the rail (a footfall every 6.5 f)

rail_4.source: cast.ts S4.rail (probed): his hands grip the rail and he leans over it

shout_4.source: the shout 'Ninety percent full!' (lip flaps ninety .. shoutEnd): mix.py's metal-tank echo

tick_4.source: cast.ts tick = clamp01((f - X) / L) (probed): the graphite check mark from the stroke's first visible frame (X + 2), L f long [onset, length]

taps_4.source: A3 ADD: the inspector taps his pencil twice on the clipboard in the 'ground...|believed' silence, one beat before the tick (CHAR: two 2-3 f pencil dips on these frames)

stamps_5.source: cast.ts STAMPS5.R (probed): the banker's right hand stamps (the picture's landing frames)

stamps_5L.source: cast.ts STAMPS5.L (probed): the left hand's stamps, half way between the beats

dings_5.source: sets_int.ts: the cash stacks pop taller on more1 / more2 (smooth((f - more) / 8)): the register bells from 3 f after, the top bell in the breath after 'more.'

ratchet_6.source: sets_int.ts: TINO'S OIL pile grows: stage 1 on moreOf, stage 2 on united

marker_6.source: A3 ADD: a felt-marker squeak as each stage of TINO'S OIL is drawn onto the chart (under the ratchet)

papers_6.source: cast.ts pap = gest2(f, X, L, ...) (probed): Tino raises the fan of OIL RECEIPTS on 'papers' (the paper rustle, A2 P3)

drums_6.source: sets_int.ts drumSlot t: stage 1 = moreOf - 3 + 2 n (7 drums), stage 2 = united - 3 + 1.08 n (26 drums): one tonk per drum landing

clock_6.source: shot 6: the wall clock's second hand steps on every whole second of the film clock (frame % 30 == 0; the bank bed's clock has the same phase) - WORLD-INT: step the second hand on these frames

drone_7.source: A2 ADD: the empty tank's hollow drone under the mystery, swelling on 'look inside?', cut with the bloop

creak_7.source: shot 7: the lender leans in over the hatch on 'someone': the steel lid / roof plate creaks

bloop_7.source: cast.ts ring / sets_ext.ts BL (probed): the bubble pops at the reflection's chin as 'inside?' ends (the bloop's pop lands on it)

drip_7.source: A3 ADD: after the bloop, one drop falls from the hatch rim into the near-empty tank: a hollow drip and the steel cavity's 1.2 s answer, faded under 'Then,' (the 'inside?|Then' gap)

phones_8.source: shot 8: desk phones ringing on the trading floor (one in the '1963,|his' breath)

crash_8.source: sets_int.ts: the chalk line dives on 'crashed' (dive = f >= crashed1) + story KICK

groan_8.source: shot 8: the traders' dismayed 'ohhh' under the THOOM's tail (CHAR: the staggered shock); A2: it rises at the END of the word 'crashed.' (never on it)

tickbell_8.source: A2 ADD: a ticker machine's bell on 'November' (a quote comes in); A3 P3: at bed level, carved (no ticker machine's hammer in frame yet)

chalk_8.source: A3 ADD: a short chalk squeal on the diving line in the breath after 'crashed.' (under the THOOM's tail)

handset_8.source: cast.ts SLAM + gest2 rise (probed): trader 3 slams his handset down onto the phone base at his hip

lightning_9.source: SaladOil.tsx FLASHES / sets_ext.ts flashAt (probed): [flash frame, far]: a near flash in a breath gets its crack ON the flash; one that lands on a word ('bust') gets its thunder late, in the next breath (light first, sound after); a far flash's roll 4 f after it

slap_9.source: sets_ext.ts: the BANKRUPT notice appears at f >= bust - 2

splash_9.source: A3 ADD: the slap knocks the water off the sign's gutter lip: a short splash under the BANKRUPT notice

lenders_9.source: cast.ts shot 9 (CHAR): lenders 0 / 2 / 3 of TF.lenderFile start walking in through the gate at lenders - 6 + 6 k' (a footfall every 10 f: walk phase / 20, a step per half cycle) - wet steps + rain on their umbrellas

ladder_9.source: cast.ts shot 9 (CHAR): the far climber's feet snap to the treads, a step every 15 f from lenders - 30 (lands 6 f in)

blips_10.source: shot 10: tiny bubbles in the held breath after 'Inside...'

slosh_10.source: BUILD_PLAN shot 10: ONE slosh after 'water.' (waterEnd), in the music's silence (peaks inside the gap)

shake_11.source: cast.ts bottleShake (probed): the hand shakes the bottle from 'Ever' (amplitude sin(pi t / len), sin(w t) strokes)

glug_11.source: sets_int.ts: the oil rises smooth((f - theOilRises) / (top + 8 - theOilRises))

clunk_11.source: cast.ts kitchen: after the shake the hand lifts the bottle (pop, ever + 24 .. 29) and sets it down: a soft glass clunk on the table

chirps_11.source: sets_int.ts kitchen: the sparrow on the fence hops every 45 f of the video clock (VF % 45 < 9): one chirrup per hop

fish_12.source: A3 P2: the fish drops from the pipe into the rising water: one small 'blub' in the 'water,|add' breath

trickle_12.source: sets_int.ts: the oil stream po = thin - 2 .. oilIn + 12

ding_12.source: shot 12: the tag ding in the gap just after 'full.' (LOOKS FULL)

blip_12.source: A2 P3: dropped - the fish has left the tank by 'full.' (no source)

valves_13.source: cast.ts PULLS13 (probed): each worker's hand-over-hand pulls (30 deg per 10 f pull); the first pull of each burst squeals

drips_13.source: sets_int.ts (probed): the gold drip off the flange lands every 40 f (VF % 40 == 12)

knock_13.source: shot 13: a far pipe knock down the line under 'tank to tank'

blob_13.source: sets_int.ts / story.ts: the blob rides the pipe tank A -> C (COUNT_AT[0] - 4 .. [2])

steam_13.source: A2 ADD: a steam puff from a valve on the second COUNTED plate; A3 P3: only when WORLD-INT's puff on 'got' is in the picture (probed: not found - dropped)

squelch_13.source: A3 ADD: the blob lands at each COUNTED plate with a tiny wet squelch, 1 f before the plate's bell (COUNT_AT - 2)

pclock_13.source: A3 ADD: the pump-room wall clock (sets_int.ts prClock) ticks on every whole second of the film clock, very low under the night bed

sweat_13.source: cast.ts: tired = f >= hardestW - 2 (a sweat drop) ...

sigh_13.source: the blob's tired sigh: in the true silence after 'America.' (computed)

tyre_14.source: A3 ADD: a far 1960s car's tyres hiss past on the grey street (off screen, two blocks down), peaking in the 'crashed.|But' breath

clack_14.source: sets_ext.ts: the CLOSED sign is visible from shares - 2

bwomp_14.source: sets_ext.ts: the SHARES arrows drop at f >= crashed2 - 2

gull_16.source: shot 16: a far gull in the gap 'fake.|The' (WORLD-EXT's gull shadow is gone by then)
